headline: 黄色ブドウ球菌のMurJの構造が、初めて明らかになった
subhead: 外向きと内向きの2状態をクライオ電顕で解析し、大腸菌のMurJと同じ型の動きを示した

summary.question: 外膜をもたない単膜細菌のMurJ（脂質IIの輸送体）は、配列の違いが大きく、構造が未解析だった。
summary.approach: 黄色ブドウ球菌のMurJ（SaMurJ）を、ナノボディやBRIL融合を使ってクライオ電顕で解析し、大腸菌MurJと比べた。
summary.result: SaMurJの外向き型（3.6 Å）と内向き型（3.5 Å）が決まり、全体の折れ畳みは大腸菌MurJと同じ型だった。
summary.learned: SaMurJも2つの状態を行き来する交互アクセス機構で脂質IIを運ぶと考えられる。
summary.open: SaMurJは大腸菌での機能補完ができず、脂質IIの認識の違いが関わる可能性がある。

question.quote: While MurJ from diderm bacteria has been structurally resolved in multiple conformational states, its monoderm homolog remains uncharacterized.
Monoderm MurJ homologs exhibit substantial sequence divergence yet retain the same lipid II flipping function and are promising antibiotic targets.

approach.quote: As an alternative, we used the ALFA-tag system (26), appending the ALFA peptide to the C-terminus of SaMurJ (SaMurJALFA) (Fig. S2A) and forming a complex with an anti-ALFA-tag nanobody (26) (Fig. S2B).

we deleted the first seven N-terminal residues of SaMurJ (SaMurJ8-553BRIL), which resulted in a more rigid attachment of BRIL to TM1 of SaMurJ8-553 and enabled a high-resolution reconstruction to 3.5 Å

result.quote: Here we report structures of Staphylococcus aureus MurJ (SaMurJ) captured in both outward- and inward-facing conformations.
A structural alignment of the OFS SaMurJ and EcMurJ reveals they have similar overall architecture (Figs. 1, G and H, S5B) (RMSD for equivalent residues of 1.3 Å).

learned.quote: These structures show that SaMurJ adopts the conserved MOP family fold and undergoes conformational transitions consistent with an alternating-access mechanism.

open.quote: This lack of complementation may reflect differences in lipid II substrate recognition, as S. aureus lipid II contains an additional pentaglycine modification (29, 30).

highlights.text: SaMurJは大腸菌のMurJと配列が17%しか同じでないが、コアの12本の膜貫通ヘリックスと追加の2本（TM13-14）を持つ。著者は単膜細菌の脂質II輸送体の初めての構造だとしている。

evidence.quote: Despite low sequence conservation between diderm and monoderm MurJ (17% identity between Sa and Ec), the structure showed that SaMurJ has a canonical MOP transporter core consisting of 12 TMs in two lobes
providing the first structural view of a monoderm lipid II flippase.

highlights.text: 脂質IIのリン酸基を結ぶとされる正電荷の3つ組（K22-R176-K302）のR176をAlaに変えると、SaMurJは内向き型で止まった。この3つ組が基質の認識と構造変化を結びつけるという見方を支える。

evidence.quote: The SaMurJALFA R176A adopts an inward-facing conformation that is similar to the inward-facing structure captured using the BRIL fusion (Fig. 2F).

Consistent with this model, we show that mutation of R176 traps MurJ in an inward-facing conformation, supporting that the cationic triad plays a key role in coupling substrate engagement to conformational transitions during the transport cycle

highlights.text: 大腸菌MurJでヘリックスを折る保存配列G/A-E-G-AがSaMurJにはなく、G62とP64が蝶番になるとみられる。単膜と二膜の違いは、選択的な阻害剤を狙う手がかりになりうる。

evidence.quote: This is likely achieved by the conserved residues G62 and P64 in TM2 (ConSurf conservation grade 9 for both), which are positioned to function as a hinge that accommodates TM2 bending during conformational transitions.
In contrast, structural features unique to monoderm or diderm MurJ may provide opportunities for selective inhibition.

lab_notes.expression: pETDuet ベクターで大腸菌 NiCo21 (DE3) に発現。IPTG 400 μM、18 °C で一晩。
lab_notes.construct: SaMurJ1-553 の C 末端に ALFA-10xHis。内向き型は N 末端の 7 残基を欠く 8-553 に BRIL を融合。
lab_notes.purification: LMNG で可溶化し、Ni-NTA → Superdex 200 ゲル濾過。野生型と BRIL 融合体には CHS を添加。
lab_notes.sample_prep: 抗 ALFA ナノボディ、または BAG2 Fab と抗 Fab ナノボディと複合体化。FOM を加え、Vitrobot Mark IV で凍結。
lab_notes.data_collection: Titan Krios＋K3（300 kV）、cryoSPARC v4.6.1 で処理。Coot・Phenix でモデル構築。

evidence.quote: pETDuet vector containing S. aureus MurJ1-553 (WT or R176A mutant) with a C-terminal ALFA-10xHis tag (SaMurJALFA), S. aureus MurJ8-553 with an N-terminal BRIL fusion domain and a C-terminal 10xHis tag (SaMurJBRIL)
Protein expression was induced by adding 400 μM Isopropyl β-D-1-thiogalactopyranoside (IPTG) and the culture was grown overnight (approximately 16 h).

Eluted protein was concentrated to approximately 500 μl using a 30 kDa MWCO Centrifugal filter (Amicon) and subjected to a Superdex 200 Increase 10/300 Gl size exclusion chromatography column (Cytiva)
Purified SaMurJBRIL sample was incubated with 1.2-fold and 1.4-fold molar excess of BAG2 Fab and elbow Nb at 4 °C for 1 h.
0.05% Fluorinated Octyl Maltoside (FOM, Anatrace) was added prior to vitrification.

Cryo-EM data were acquired at the Caltech cryo-EM Facility on an FEI Titan Krios operated at an acceleration voltage of 300 kV and equipped with an energy filter and a K3 direct electron detector (Gatan) in correlated double sampling mode.
All cryo-EM data processing was performed in cryoSPARC (36) (v4.6.1).

editor_notes: Q2FXH6 は PDB で初めての構造（prior_pdb_count 0）で、論文も「first structural view of a monoderm lipid II flippase」と書くため初構造タグを付けた。大腸菌 MurJ の外向き型（11XY）も同時に報告している。脂質II結合モデルは Chai-1 の予測で実験構造ではないので、記事では扱わなかった。本文は欠けていない。
